title: AI nuclear power firm Fermi finally has a new CEO | TechCrunch
summary: Fermi said Wednesday it has hired Lee McIntire, an independent member of the company’s board who has held chief executive positions at CH2M Hill and TerraPower , the nuclear power startup founded by Bill Gates.
